examples.reply:

Tim's mom saw him crying and asked, "Why are you sad, Tim?" Tim said, "My toy car is broken. I can't play with it." His mom said, "Let's try to fix it together."
They found some glue and put the toy car back together. Tim was happy again. He said, "Thank you, Mom!" They played with the toy car together and had lots of fun.
